title: Arjuna: The Warrior Who Would Not Fight

source_integrity.translation_policy: New original paraphrase only; do not quote protected translations

image_reference.style_board_prompt: Create one horizontal 3:1 cohesive six-beat visual development frieze for Arjuna: The Warrior Who Would Not Fight in Indian illuminated manuscript miniature, saffron dust, jewel pigments, Krishna chariot. scenes.caption: What if winning a war meant fighting the people you loved? At Kurukshetra, the archer Arjuna looked across the armies and saw his own teachers, cousins and relatives facing him. Victory suddenly looked like a catastrophe.
